subject: Way to pull down copies of files on my shinyapps deployment?

messages.author: 084d0345d2a3706f
messages.subject: Way to pull down copies of files on my shinyapps deployment?
parts:
Let’s say i have a shiny app deployed that generates some output files (i.e.: the final output after running some kind of optimization problem). Is there any way for me to copy from the shinyapp server to my computer?

Thanks!
-Justin

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Way to pull down copies of files on my shinyapps deployment?
parts:
Hi Justin,
I would recommend you take a look at the following article: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/share-data.html  which we released the other day.  It talks about the different ways in which you can preserve your data across sessions.  
We would appreciate any feedback you have on the article.

Best,
Tareef
